svg.aria-label: Kart Party tracks: Party Ring, Parkside, Harbour Hairpins, Neon Blocks, Summit Switchback, Sunset Strand

g.text: and a gentle S through the park.
A long dock straight into two tight
hairpins, a chicane and a fast sweeper home.
Right angles round city blocks, sliding barriers
and a building-site shortcut for boosters.
Hairpins up the mountain, a jump over the
top, rolling boulders and a narrow bridge.
A long seafront loop with boost lanes, a
dune jump and a boardwalk across the bay.
